envelope.description: Qualify installed rollout and run the final sweep

body.title: Qualify installed rollout and run the final sweep
body.summary: Exercise the installed macOS LaunchAgent on disposable roots and regular Apple Silicon, including hung close, partial boot, legacy cutover, version-changing rollback and recovery. Verify Linux regressions, then run the complete sweep after all implementation tasks.
acceptanceChecks: Installed smoke proves verified generation change and safe rollback
All implementation tasks have relevant targeted test evidence before the final sweep
Managed installed activation is release-qualified only after the installed smoke and regression checks pass

tests.name: Install or upgrade into supported launchd domain
Normal and blocked shutdown complete with verified generation change
Restart leaves one daemon and serves status and indexing
Stopped daemon remains stopped and rollback preserves state
On the installed Apple Silicon build recover stale owned PID and socket files and refuse files belonging to a replacement
Real macOS migration exit observation and restoration after injected pre-readiness failure
Apple Silicon real blocked-close guard recovery and boot timeout after partial publication
Apple Silicon installed update across a supervisor version change with injected rollback
